name: pianoflow
description: Offline Synthesia-style piano trainer for Android tablets (BLE MIDI, USB MIDI, wait mode, mistake detection).

scripts.android:init: npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && node scripts/patch-android.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
